name: family-trip-budget
description: See what a family trip really costs before you book: flights, hotel, food, parks and the hidden fees, for your family and your month.

interface.longDescription: Ask what a trip will cost for your family and get a clear estimate in seconds: getting there, the hotel, food, getting around, parks and activities, and the extras people forget, like resort fees and departure taxes. Works for city breaks, all inclusive resorts, cruises and theme parks. Every figure shows a low to high range, where it came from and how sure we are. Children's ages count, so seats, tickets and meals are priced right. If we do not have data for a place, it tells you instead of guessing. Built for parents planning a family trip. Estimates are planning figures from our price data, not live quotes, and the tool never books anything. Open the full budget on Endless Travel Plans for live fares and rates.
interface.defaultPrompt: What would a week in Orlando cost for 2 adults and kids aged 6 and 10?
